titles.en: Eulogy of the Tang Restoration, cliff inscription

dimensions.raw: 高 310 厘米，宽 320 厘米；字径约 15 厘米
dimensions.note: 21 lines, read leftwards; the character total is disputed.

currentCollection.note: Cut into the 峿台 rock face at Wuxi and described as intact.
currentCollection.noteZh: 刻于浯溪峿台崖壁，来源称现状完整。

provenanceEvents.summary: Cut into the cliff in 771; later visitors added inscriptions on the same rock.
provenanceEvents.summaryZh: 771 年刻于崖壁；此后黄庭坚、何绍基等在同一石区续刻题记。

review.note: Draft object record from two government pages that disagree on the character count.
review.noteZh: 依据两份政府页面整理的草稿；两份材料所记字数不一致。

notes: The two cited pages give 242 and 332 characters; the record keeps both and asserts neither.
The height and width come from the Yongzhou page; the Hunan page gives no measurements.
The pages say the cliff is intact but give no condition survey or conservation record.
notesZh: 所引两份页面分别记 242 字与 332 字；本条两存而不裁断。
高宽数据来自永州市页面，湖南省页面未给尺寸。
页面称崖面现状完整，但没有保存状况调查或保护记录。
